notes.title: 0.20.0 - Vibes
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

In this patch we have worked on improving general performance, and also at the same time give players a more Arena vibe with updated audience platforms.  
Gameplay flow has also been reworked, and a lot of preparations under the hood for further updates of the game, so stay tuned for more!

Gameplay


 Removed the lobby platform and replaced it with an intermission camera


Audience Platforms


 Gave the audience a new fresh look
 Updated the levels to fit with the new audience platforms
 Everest changed from daytime to nighttime
 Rumble Rafts got some new more optimized water
 Changed out the loading screens to show the updated levels
 General levels optimizations

notes.title: 0.19.0 - Curveball
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Here comes the patch for the upcoming playtest weekend!

We've made some impactful changes that should add more freedom and depth to the gameplay. We’re excited to hear your feedback!

UPDATED ABILITY


Dash

 Now has 3 charges.
 If a player deflects while dashing, the ball will curve in the direction of the dash.



NEW MECHANIC


Ball curving

 Players can now curve the ball by deflecting while dashing:

 Dash left → Ball curves left
 Dash right → Ball curves right
 Dash forward → Deflects harder forward
 Dash backward → Temporarily slows down the ball




Dev note: The ball will still target the player you’re looking at, but if you dash left while deflecting, it will curve left toward your target.  
Dev note 2: This is our first iteration of ball curving. We have more ideas for refining the mechanic, but we’d love your feedback before making further changes! [THANKS EMOTE]

VFX


 New kill markers added:

 Gravestone
 Flower
 Trash Can



Dev note: These kill markers are tied to player level progression and can be unlocked by playing.

Bug Fixes


 Fixed an issue where players retained velocity from the lobby when spawning into the arena.
 Fixed an issue with the sprint animation.
 Fixed a bug where Mega Jump VFX could spawn multiple times.
 Fixed some sound issues related to sudden death.

notes.title: 0.18.0 - Vissko and Everest
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Here comes the patch for the upcoming playtest weekend!

The playtest will have specific time slots—check in-game or join our Discord to see when you can play!

Characters


 New Character: Viskko


Levels


 New Arena: Everest


Ball


 Improved how the ball syncs between server and client. It should now feel more consistent when flying and orbiting players.


Deflect


 Players within 5m of someone using Deflect will now be pushed away. This change helps prevent players from stacking on top of each other.


Yoyo


 The ball will now curve back toward the player who used the ability instead of instantly changing direction.


Dev Note: We've noticed that Yoyo is a bit too strong in its current state. This tweak makes it require more skill to time correctly, as the ball now curves back rather than snapping instantly. We'll monitor this change and make further adjustments if needed.

Kill Effects


 New Feature (Testing Phase): Kill effects now play at the location where a player is eliminated.
 Gravestone Kill Effect has been implemented as the default for testing.


Dev Note: Kill effects will be customizable in the future, with new ones available to unlock or purchase. For now, we’ve added one for testing—more to come!

VFX


 Reworked Mega Jump effect.
 Updated Jump and Double Jump VFX.
 Updated Dash VFX.


Bug Fixes


 Fixed an issue where killboxes (falling off the arena) were not launching players correctly.
 Fixed an issue where players could be spam-hacked.
 Fixed a visual bug that allowed throwable spam.
 Fixed an issue with ball pathfinding where it didn't account for the ball's size.

notes.title: Patch 0.17.2 - Next Fest Hotfix 2
notes.content:
Changes


 EXCLUSIVE player profile icon! “Next Fest 2025 DEMO”  
    This icon will be granted to all players who launch the game after this patch. Access to the icon will be removed once the demo ends, so don’t miss out!
 Input Rebind Settings (WORK IN PROGRESS)  
    Dev note: We've added a very early BETA version of the input rebind page. It has several issues and may break, but we want as many players as possible to enjoy the final weekend of the demo. If you encounter any problems, press [RESET TO DEFAULTS] on the input rebind page!
 Added Easy Anti-Cheat to improve security and prevent unfair play.
 Adjusted round timer reduction on player death: 20s → 10s  
    Dev note: We read your feedback and agree that sudden death is being triggered too quickly, especially in full 6-player matches. This change should help rounds last a bit longer before sudden death kicks in.
 Improved in-game clarity about match structure:  
    
     Displaying "Round X" at the start of each round before the timer begins.
     Added round progress indicators under the timer at the top of the screen.  
    Dev note: This is still a work-in-progress, and we’ll be refining it in future updates!
     Added an extra confirmation pop-up when attempting to exit back to the main menu.
    
 Introduced a "Waiting for Players" stage during the loading screen when entering a server.


Bug Fixes


 Fixed an issue where bots and players could escape Rumble Rafts Arena and go under the water.
 Fixed an issue where the four center rafts in Rumble Rafts wouldn't appear correctly for clients after a round started on high-latency servers.
 Fixed an issue where the cat head would remain stuck on players after being hacked.
 Fixed an issue where the ball would incorrectly lock onto a player during the sudden death timer if they used the yo-yo just before sudden death began.


Let us know what you think of these changes, and as always, thanks for playing!

notes.title: Patch 0.17.1 - Next Fest Hotfix
notes.content:
Changes


 Bots will now fill empty slots in servers and replace players who leave mid-match.


Dev Note: We're testing this feature to ensure a smoother experience when players drop out. Our goal is to keep matches balanced and engaging for those who want to play through to the end. Let us know what you think!

Bug Fixes


 Fixed an issue that caused character movement to stutter.
 Fixed a bug where weapons would sometimes float in the air.
 Adjusted bot AI—turns out they were a little too smart. They should behave more appropriately now!
 Fixed a sound bug that caused ability audio (such as bomb or jump pad placement) to spam for all players when placed out of bounds.
 Resolved an overlapping UI issue in the main menu.

notes.title: Patch 0.16.0 - “Next Fest”
notes.content:

Ability VFX and Visuals


 Yoyo

 Redirect

notes.title: Patch 0.14.0 - “Sudden Death”
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

We’ve just released a new patch, bringing more polish and improvements! This update expands on the sudden death mechanic and enhances the overall game flow leading into sudden death. Check it out and let us know what you think!

Change log:

Sudden Death

We’re continuing to improve the sudden death flow. We’re currently testing a full match reset where players are moved back to their original spawn points. This gives us a chance to showcase sudden death effects while giving players a moment to understand the situation and catch their breath.

Sudden Death General

 Sudden death now resets the ball and triggers a new 3-second countdown.


Sudden Death Mechanic

 Short Deflect  
    
     A sudden death effect that shortens deflect duration, making it harder for players to time their deflects.
    


Localization

We’ve started working on localization! This is a WIP, and we’ll continue to add support for more languages as we move forward.


 Added a language option in settings:  
    
     Settings > Gameplay > Language
    


Ball


 Added an outline to the ball to make it even clearer when it’s targeting the player.
 Added a ground decal under the ball to help players track its position when it’s high above them.


Ability


 Place Jump Pad  
    
     Increased jump pad lifetime from 6s to 12s.
     Increased jump pad launch force from 3000 to 4500.
    
 Videos  
    
     Updated explanation videos for all abilities.
    


Friend List and Party


 Friend list is now sorted by online status, then by name.
 Added “Invite to Party” option in the friends menu dropdown.
 New popup for friend requests.


VFX


 Updated Visuals for Abilities  
    
     Speed Boost
     Power Boost
    


Bugs


 Fixed an issue with the decal shadow under the player not displaying correctly on platforms in Rumble Rafts.
 Fixed formatting issues with “Time in Queue” and “Estimated Time in Queue.”
 Fixed an issue with player introductions where the wrong player level was displayed.

notes.title: Blade Ball Arena is coming to Next Fest!
notes.content:
Exciting news!


Major League Curveball is now Blade Ball Arena!
We’re incredibly proud to collaborate with the creators of the smash hit Blade Ball on Roblox to bring this exciting game to Steam.

Mark your calendars, Blade Ball Arena will be part of Steam Next Fest starting February 24th! Dive into fast-paced, action-packed gameplay and be among the first players to experience the arena. Don’t forget to wishlist Blade Ball Arena now and stay tuned for updates, trailers, and more by following us on our social channels:

Discord | Instagram | X (Twitter) | TikTok | YouTube | Website 

See you in the arena!
